definitions.explanation: An educational institution for children aged 3-5, focused on early childhood education before elementary school.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{来年|らいねん}{幼稚園|ようちえん}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: My son will enter kindergarten next year.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園|ようちえん}の{遠足|えんそく}で{動物園|どうぶつえん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: We went to the zoo on a kindergarten field trip.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園|ようちえん}の{入園式|にゅうえんしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: I attended the kindergarten entrance ceremony.

notes:
{幼稚園|ようちえん} is a compound: {幼稚|ようち} (young/immature) + {園|えん} (garden/institution).

CONTRAST WITH {保育園|ほいくえん}:
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}: Education-focused, shorter hours, managed by Ministry of Education
- {保育園|ほいくえん}: Childcare-focused, longer hours, managed by Ministry of Health

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}に{通|かよ}う (to attend kindergarten)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}{児|じ} (kindergarten child)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}の{先生|せんせい} (kindergarten teacher)
- {入園|にゅうえん}する (to enroll in kindergarten)

EDUCATION SYSTEM:
In Japan, {幼稚園|ようちえん} accepts children ages 3-5 ({年少|ねんしょう}・{年中|ねんちゅう}・{年長|ねんちょう}). After kindergarten, children enter {小学校|しょうがっこう} (elementary school) at age 6.
